# Changelog

Generated by `frob release changelog` from `changelog.d/` fragments; compiled at release, never hand-edited.

## 0.1.2 - 2026-10-14

#### Changed

- The probe now reports running jobs per repository, so a repository with no recorded memory peak waits only behind its own runs rather than behind every goway job on the helper. (~8RVD8CV, 01M44TCANTN1ZSR2RGN8RVD8CV)
- goway now installs its remote script once per version on each Unix helper (verified by sha256, reinstalled when missing or modified) and sends only a short command line per call, instead of the whole script with every call, which neared the argument size limit. A helper that cannot keep a copy still gets the script inline. (~0B12Y4D, 01M4557B4FQ51Y1T49Y0B12Y4D)
- A cargo run with no memory record for its command now starts at lowered jobs (assuming 1 GiB fixed plus 1 GiB per job) and says why, instead of full parallelism that could exhaust a small helper; once a peak is recorded it replaces the guess. (~J9K1RQQ, 01M48BQFCPGPRH99HZYJ9K1RQQ)
- The fitted memory model now carries a 15% safety margin, so its estimate stays at or above every recorded peak instead of undershooting runs that scatter above the fitted line. (~NK26EQE, 01M4GPJPH76ABDNDXKDNK26EQE)

#### Fixed

- goway doctor's Windows facts probe no longer hangs on a stuck rustup or vswhere: both now run under a 10 second limit enforced on the Windows host, are killed with their process tree when it expires, and a warning says which probe timed out. (~0RKW5RF, 01M44QABBBGGQFS25HF0RKW5RF)
- goway-setup tune now refuses a WSL memory size that leaves Windows under 3 GB (or a quarter of the RAM on large machines), naming the RAM, the request and the largest safe size, unless --force is given; tune --memory max picks that size, and goway doctor warns about a helper whose .wslconfig already starves Windows and prints the tune command that fixes it. (~EPZMT2B, 01M44QW7SEHV2EJP5H1EPZMT2B)
- `goway changes` now shows a pinned-tool install as one line naming the tool, version and host (for example "installed uv 0.12.23 user-level on HOST at 2026-10-14 09:30") with a local time instead of a unix time and no whole fix script, and `goway changes undo` removes that tool tree and its links through the fix journal. (~482YN88, 01M44RBYY6SD0N8H3WX482YN88)
- goway's own tests no longer leave real systemd scopes behind on a helper when they run inside a goway run: test worlds use a fake systemd-run unless a test opts into a real scope. (~2F9Q3NC, 01M44RCJMHYZCZJDE3B2F9Q3NC)
- A short run on a Windows helper no longer ends with a warning that the lifeline broke: the lifeline closing together with a finished job is normal, and the warning is printed only when the lifeline ended while the job was still running. (~GBBWKBV, 01M44W0PBH0DCNASHP3GBBWKBV)
- Piping install.sh into sh (dash on Debian and Ubuntu) now stops with "this installer needs bash, not sh" and the `| bash` command, instead of "set: Illegal option -o pipefail". (~Z31VW6Y, 01M45D1XYFTD3NAV2BJZ31VW6Y)
- `goway uninstall` no longer deletes the records of changes on helpers it cannot undo: helpers that are not in the config but have active records are kept and named with the command that undoes them, and `--everywhere` deletes a helper's record only after its changes were undone. (~MM4GRP6, 01M45D6N0V2XF3CZFD1MM4GRP6)
- install.sh now upgrades an existing install in place instead of asking for `goway uninstall` first: it replaces the binary it installed (refusing, and naming the file, if it was changed by hand) and updates the install journal, so uninstall stays exact. (~QYFK0KC, 01M45D6N5HJJ6VVK0XNQYFK0KC)
- Peaks recorded for memory fitting are now kept per repository and per command, so a light run (such as a nextest run) on a small helper is no longer judged by the peak of a heavy one (such as a full CI run). (~7ASVM8H, 01M4GPJF9TZ9FXETB4G7ASVM8H)
- Long runs no longer end with "the lifeline connection to HOST broke while the job ran (ssh exit status: 0)": a lifeline that ends cleanly as the job ends is not reported as broken. (~F2WWHE0, 01M4GPJFQAPBRSEJJT4F2WWHE0)
- Helper installs on WSL 2.5 and later no longer fail and roll back at the last step: WSL disabled sparse virtual disks and refuses to make one unless asked with --allow-unsafe, so goway now retries with that flag when WSL asks for it, and a failed wsl command shows WSL's own message. (~9SC8EN4, 01M4WB91QMTXFBW34MT9SC8EN4)
- goway-setup install --host and tune no longer assume the Ubuntu distro: without --distro they use the WSL default distro when it is Ubuntu or Debian, else the only such distro installed, and with several candidates and no default they list them and ask for --distro NAME instead of suggesting wsl --install. (~62N3Z9H, 01M4WB91TXX36PQBHJ862N3Z9H)
- goway-setup.exe no longer demands administrator rights just to start: it embeds an asInvoker manifest so Windows' installer detection (triggered by "setup" in the file name) stays out of the way, and only the real host install elevates, through its own prompt. (~6ETEFBQ, 01M4WB91WSA62K363KR6ETEFBQ)
- `goway doctor` no longer warns "no ssh key found" when the host config names goway's own identity key and its .pub exists; it still warns when neither the agent, the ssh defaults nor the host identity provides a key. (~YPB8VS9, 01M4WB98GJNV6VG7GHZYPB8VS9)
- goway-setup install --host now works again after a failed or undone install: openssh-server left in dpkg state rc (removed, configuration kept, which is what goway's apt-get remove produces) is reinstalled instead of refused, without purging, so the helper presents the same host key. (~VGZJ67Q, 01M4WCD71X8MECXX1QFVGZJ67Q)

## 0.1.1 - 2026-10-12

#### Added

- goway run --shard N splits one run across the N least-loaded hosts: cargo nextest run gets nextest's own --partition count:i/N, every command sees GOWAY_SHARD and GOWAY_SHARD_COUNT, output lines are prefixed with the host, and any failing shard fails the run. (~D4TJVJS, 01M41AV1JM5RCN804G0D4TJVJS)
- New: goway add HELPER registers a helper laptop in one command (local check, confirmed host key, key login with one password, toolchain), --rsudo runs the helper's administrator changes after one confirmation in a single sudo session, --lsudo installs missing tools on this laptop, and rerunning it changes nothing; goway doctor --sudo is now --rsudo. (~WYXXE81, 01M41J9EJQR571J5GCSWYXXE81)
- New: goway uninstall removes everything goway added on every helper (state, the tools it installed, its key line; administrator changes with --rsudo; system packages are listed, not removed) and then on this laptop (config, keys, state, and the program via the install record); without --everywhere it lists everything and asks first, and --dry-run only lists. (~6E94E0H, 01M41J9ES9F9KQKHS5Q6E94E0H)
- goway-setup install --host now prints the helper's name, ssh host key fingerprint and the exact goway add command, registers its own Add/Remove Programs entry, stops early with WSL setup steps when WSL is missing, and asks before restarting WSL. (~HDJ5HFB, 01M41J9F45EY1FPVVV9HDJ5HFB)
- goway-setup install --host --network auto|mirrored|nat: on Windows 10 and Windows 11 without mirrored networking the helper is reached through a journaled netsh portproxy relay that a scheduled task keeps pointed at WSL, and uninstall removes it exactly. (~V529TMA, 01M41MX7VKXP4S8HASWV529TMA)
- A Mac with Homebrew's GNU tools can be a helper: the remote script adapts to macOS and goway doctor --fix installs the tools without sudo. (~FKHDK2A, 01M41P2FRR6AYWFFZA2FKHDK2A)
- macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) gets release binaries, wheels and a portable install.sh that verifies downloads with shasum. (~NW5SF9B, 01M41P2FTWWZGR0Q5JTNW5SF9B)
- goway run --shard now splits pytest, go test, Maven, Gradle and RSpec by file, package or class and uses native sharding for vitest, jest, Playwright, Catch2, GoogleTest, CTest and nextest. (~21HE9YF, 01M41P2FWVAT5AP3XD121HE9YF)
- Persistent slot trees: update each build slot in place instead of copy-then-delete; dependency dirs stay warm. (~RY6QS01, 01M41P2FZ22KC8PJVR9RY6QS01)
- goway doctor now reads the project it runs in and checks each host only for the tools that project needs, with pinned, checksum-verified user-level fixes, and honours goway.toml [toolchain]. (~XP4RZVS, 01M41P2G171VZJW77Z1XP4RZVS)
- A host can now be a Windows machine over OpenSSH with PowerShell, or the Windows side of this machine through powershell.exe, and goway host add detects Windows. (~995C0C6, 01M41Q6CX4RRFZT58EE995C0C6)
- Windows hosts now have their remote side, remote.ps1: the same verbs, persistent slot trees, copy integrity, GPU slots, shard detection and gc as Linux, installed once per version and tested under pwsh and Windows PowerShell. (~PG3XK9R, 01M41Q6D3QBJ6N93Q2HPG3XK9R)
- Windows hosts (OpenSSH or WSL interop) now work through the whole pipeline: run, sync, status, gc and sharded runs speak PowerShell to them, install the remote script on first use and report the host's os and architecture. (~0JYK9C5, 01M41Q6D98JC3F9H43F0JYK9C5)
- Rust on Windows hosts: every repository gets a persistent cargo target directory so reruns are warm, and the run report records os windows and the host's own architecture. (~YGM627C, 01M41Q6DFH1EXKZXZ4WYGM627C)
- goway doctor now checks Windows hosts (OpenSSH or WSL interop) with the same transport as run: Build Tools, rustup with the msvc target, cargo-nextest and the system drive, each with an exact fix command. (~TRQRCBB, 01M41Q6DMFXAD67P17VTRQRCBB)
- Install and uninstall through uv, pipx, pip and cargo: documented, and goway uninstall removes the program however it was installed. (~NKCC1DM, 01M41QWW2EGAQGFSV4QNKCC1DM)
- goway run --host local runs the command in the current work tree without syncing, and a [local] section can opt this machine into the pool (pool, max_jobs, margin) or make it the fallback when no helper is reachable; goway status shows its row. (~NMXT7K6, 01M41SDVD25MA7AX1DHNMXT7K6)
- goway run --shard now gives each host a share of the tests proportional to its free cores for nextest and the file, package and class splitters, and the report lists each shard's share. (~3Y6T2FJ, 01M41SDZPWESK72BNQ03Y6T2FJ)
- goway status shows each host's RAM, GPUs and features (cached daily, refresh with --refresh), hosts short of memory score worse, and doctor flags a GPU invisible to WSL. (~3Q0VGAX, 01M41T2EDAC22Z3A6BP3Q0VGAX)
- goway run --needs (hard) and --prefers (soft) choose hosts by GPU, RAM, cores, CPU features, KVM, Docker, disk and labels, and the report records the facts that matched. (~VY53SJM, 01M41T2EH2C5MRX4SBCVY53SJM)
- A goway.toml at the repository root can carry [[rule]] needs and prefers per command glob (the command line wins and goway says which rule applied), and hosts can carry labels for --needs label=NAME. (~2SH8Y2M, 01M41T2EMRZFGJGYGC82SH8Y2M)
- A run that needs a GPU now holds one GPU slot on the host (gpu_jobs runs per GPU), with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES naming that GPU, so concurrent GPU runs no longer share one by accident. (~XKE3574, 01M41T2ERNJM7R0MCEZXKE3574)
- goway doctor compares what WSL got with the laptop's RAM, swap and processors, and goway-setup tune changes them through a journaled .wslconfig that uninstall restores; doctor also offers NVIDIA's CUDA toolkit for WSL. (~GDJCK7F, 01M41T4HF1ATS7YSPG5GDJCK7F)
- goway-setup install --host --native sets up a Windows helper without WSL through Windows' own OpenSSH Server, with every change journaled and reverted exactly (capability only if it added it); the live roundtrip on a real machine is still to be proven. (~VHRF97S, 01M41T4HJEW3W92MXGMVHRF97S)
- goway doctor --fix now installs the C++ Build Tools (winget, with administrator rights through --rsudo), rustup and cargo-nextest (pinned hashes) on Windows hosts and records each for goway uninstall. (~TQP4A3T, 01M41T4HN7VTHZZZP7ZTQP4A3T)
- goway run --shard now detects GoogleTest and Catch2 v3 test binaries on the helper by reading their embedded flag strings (never executing them), reruns a Catch2 shard once if the shard flags are rejected, and remembers failed detections locally. (~VSYHNHC, 01M41TKWAWBQ578FW3YVSYHNHC)
- goway now verifies the helper's copy of your tree by SHA-256 before every run and after every failure, and on a proven mismatch rebuilds the copy and reruns once. (~B6MRTFH, 01M41TR5C6QR3ANA1HSB6MRTFH)
- C and C++ builds under CMake now use sccache or ccache as the compiler launcher with the repository's cache, and CPM.cmake downloads share one per-repository directory, unless you set those variables yourself. (~6JC6FR2, 01M41Y5J0TM325Z5HTA6JC6FR2)
- Each helper now has a disk budget (max_disk, min_free): over it, goway evicts unlocked build slots, work dirs, seeds and caches least recently used first and reports what it freed; sccache and ccache get a 2 GiB cap per repository; goway status shows use against budget and goway gc --dry-run lists evictions. (~0ZXHQZJ, 01M41Y5J52MWX48PQ840ZXHQZJ)
- goway doctor prints a versions table (laptop and every host) and marks drift between hosts, and goway doctor --fix --all-hosts names the fleet-wide fix explicitly. (~3T7FA5K, 01M41Y9H462DH2ZJRC43T7FA5K)
- goway doctor reads CMake's own File API replies and, with --configure, runs one traced configure on each helper to name the packages a CMake project is missing, with the exact install command. (~5JN7ZPF, 01M424MWHF90WA5AGEX5JN7ZPF)
- goway doctor reads the linker and the -fuse-ld backend from cargo config and environment and checks them on every helper, offering clang, mold or lld through --rsudo. (~AWVVJCJ, 01M424MYD4HA48XG5HEAWVVJCJ)
- Windows helpers now evict least recently used entries to the disk budget, report it in probe, and cap compiler caches. (~MVTNZHA, 01M4262XD6M7F91AA2VMVTNZHA)
- goway add on a native Windows host (os = "windows") prints the exact goway-setup --authorized-key command with goway's key instead of attempting a password login. (~D18SPT3, 01M4262XJHXA83K92W5D18SPT3)
- goway-setup finds the interactive desktop by session id, so install --host started from WSL interop or ssh into WSL on a logged-in laptop shows the UAC prompt. (~AD8JP8D, 01M426GBSHQE6DMEBRJAD8JP8D)
- Windows runs append Git for Windows' usr\bin to PATH when sh is missing (never prepended), and say so in the run's notes. (~4XE3D47, 01M427TCSW8B9ZMT2HG4XE3D47)
- goway run --with-git (or with_git = true in goway.toml) gives the helper's copy a .git whose HEAD, index and status match the work tree, without remotes, credentials or hooks. (~3FFY4EN, 01M427WY4XBZ8F0E3BY3FFY4EN)
- The --rsudo switch now runs a native Windows helper's administrator step through its Windows ssh admin account (or prints the exact command), and --lsudo adds the OpenSSH client through this laptop's UAC prompt; no password is ever stored or typed. (~19PCKTH, 01M42AMDX29E13TQABY19PCKTH)
- goway add explains Permission denied (no password set, password off, wrong user, ban, AllowUsers), prints goway's key and the commands to add it by hand, and takes --no-password; documented in the troubleshooting guide. (~GXR2KV2, 01M42BHR7CAP9XQWNM2GXR2KV2)
- Keep a helper awake while a job runs (systemd-inhibit on Linux, a keep-awake request on Windows, caffeinate on macOS). (~PSR953W, 01M42BHS18MF66ZQZ69PSR953W)
- goway add prints its key and the commands to install it by hand when the helper refuses password login, then continues once the key works. (~MSXM5XE, 01M42BHSZZ5V4JD35QYMSXM5XE)
- goway doctor warns when logind kills user processes at logout without lingering (offering loginctl enable-linger through --rsudo) and when the remote root sits on an encrypted or network file system. (~VK9Z2AX, 01M42BHT6R8A6Q9HK40VK9Z2AX)
- Runs keep scratch files in goway's own root instead of /tmp, doctor reports the root's file system and free space, and a case-insensitive host refuses repositories with case-only path clashes. (~1BCT7Y3, 01M42BHTC4J3XCH5GBW1BCT7Y3)
- Failures to reach a helper now say whether the network looks like it isolates devices, blocks mDNS or has two machines answering for one name, and what to do. (~ZQETW47, 01M42BHTGMABJE3ZAPBZQETW47)
- Runs and doctor now find tools in the usual per-user directories (~/.local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, uv, node and go locations) without sourcing startup files, so a helper's user-level mold or cargo is found. (~E51QN55, 01M42BHTN4T6FJ9DDR3E51QN55)
- doctor now reports SELinux and AppArmor denials of setsid, flock or goway's shell, with the label or profile change to make. (~WR8SNXP, 01M42BHTRYPX7PM14FQWR8SNXP)
- goway doctor asks cargo metadata and go list for the Rust and Go versions a project needs, and labels text-based answers (Java, or a missing tool) as approximate. (~ZQD22QE, 01M42BTWC93QV5RKM95ZQD22QE)
- goway add now asks on a terminal whether you know the helper's password before trying one, names the helper you typed in ssh's prompt, allows one password attempt, and then walks you through pasting the key by hand. (~50Y3T7N, 01M42CPNK60AXE6WDCN50Y3T7N)
- goway doctor is quiet: one line per host, each problem once across the hosts that share it, passing checks only with --all, long text only with --explain, fixes listed once, and hardening opt-in with --harden. (~KWV0DSG, 01M42DAB5MTYFTE6W9ZKWV0DSG)
- A helper that goes to sleep or drops off the network during a job is now reported as asleep (exit 125), not as a failed command. (~CDRSRY3, 01M42DHKPTTJAZCYE3SCDRSRY3)
- goway run queues in a local first-come-first-served line when every host is at its job limit or short of memory, waiting up to --wait (default 5m, 0s fails at once). (~ZW327DY, 01M42EM74CSKZX1MHWBZW327DY)
- goway doctor now warns when a helper's shell startup files print text, with the guard to add. (~G7RAZP9, 01M42ERHA91FDR28QRFG7RAZP9)
- The pool only picks hosts of the laptop's OS unless the run pins a host or asks for another OS. (~YKNEA39, 01M42EZ3TAWHTCJ4MWVYKNEA39)
- --needs accepts shell-safe minimums such as cores:8 and mem:2G, and a bare key explains the unquoted >= redirect pitfall. (~WCBRFMA, 01M42FC4N6TYP7M8A4QWCBRFMA)
- Cross-OS runs: same OS by default, a loud hint for portable test runners, --any-os and cross_os in goway.toml, and --each-os to run once per OS. (~EDPP8DN, 01M42FJVGY91ND091THEDPP8DN)
- A program that differs by OS (python3, pip, ./gradlew, ./build/x, project [translate] entries) is translated on the host from PATH-only candidates, shown, and recorded; any doubt stops the run. (~AHHZCF5, 01M42FN011Z3NBG491XAHHZCF5)
- A run notes when its host differs from the rest of the fleet for the project tools, and --report records the tool versions of the host that ran it. (~EX16KQS, 01M42HH9DKKMRPPWNY1EX16KQS)
- goway doctor checks and installs a repository's Rust targets (user-level) and distro packages (through --rsudo, naming the repository) from goway.toml [toolchain] and rust-toolchain.toml. (~6P32EB5, 01M42KTW3HF5XY7HAZD6P32EB5)
- goway doctor now lists the proxy variables (HTTPS_PROXY and friends) set on a helper, by name only, never their values. (~C30Q9CG, 01M42QF9RYT90YDTNP7C30Q9CG)
- goway status and doctor warn when a helper clock is more than 2 s off, with the fix for WSL or Windows. (~TGZTRVF, 01M42RAM7D56M1KH49NTGZTRVF)
- goway learns each repository's disk footprint per helper, queues runs for helpers with room, makes room before a run, and explains a disk-full failure. (~VYN8F9T, 01M42RFMD7NF24476N9VYN8F9T)
- A run now refreshes a stale tool-version cache from its own probe, so drift notes work without running doctor first. (~T8B9HQV, 01M43AFK9N84ZE45CY5T8B9HQV)
- Windows helpers now have the heartbeat lifeline, keep-awake, clock epoch, tool facts and liveness-based gc protection of starting runs. (~V4A27S6, 01M43AS3TM0HGV1Q866V4A27S6)
- remote.ps1 now cleans a finished run's work dir best effort like remote.sh, and tests cover future-dated files. (~YS01CGE, 01M43CCF1E0CQW22RXDYS01CGE)
- goway now learns each repository's peak memory per helper, never places a run on a helper too small for it, queues while memory is short, and explains an out-of-memory kill. (~2NH4FTC, 01M43CWNW1JNQZMCJBQ2NH4FTC)
- An unpinned --any-os run whose command translation is in doubt on another OS now removes that host's work dir and re-picks a host of the laptop's OS instead of exiting 125. (~ZHX18YW, 01M43ETRMKFS15MWTTVZHX18YW)
- max_disk, min_free and cache_size can now be set per [[host]], overriding [defaults] on both Unix and Windows helpers. (~MG5P4GS, 01M43JBGHCD68QDZVMDMG5P4GS)
- Each job now runs in a scope capped at job_tasks processes (default 4096) with a low CPU weight, plus optional job_cpu and job_memory caps per host, and a ulimit -u fallback without systemd. (~HNJDP23, 01M44F0HBMG5K7VA1SSHNJDP23)
- goway doctor now tells a stopped WSL distro, a keepalive task that never repeats and an unreachable machine apart by asking Windows OpenSSH, and the troubleshooting page lists the same checks by hand. (~G5KZDCD, 01M44GSS1JRT16W9B5SG5KZDCD)
- A cargo or nextest run that does not fit a helper's memory at full parallelism now runs at the largest job count that does (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS and NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS), records peaks per job count, reserves memory for runs in flight, and is refused only when one job cannot fit. (~41CG5RF, 01M47SYH8F5YD6P5G2741CG5RF)
- goway run --with-ref REF (repeatable; with_refs in goway.toml) sends named refs with the helper's .git, at the same commit with its tree readable, so tools that read state from a branch work remotely. (~9JMB2P3, 01M4841FSD2PCVRH1JW9JMB2P3)
- When a run loses its connection (ssh exit 255 or the helper's exit 143), goway now prints its best guess at why (this machine slept, the network changed, the helper is unreachable, the helper stopped the job, an ssh reset, or the command's own exit), a next step, its confidence, and the evidence used. Exit codes are unchanged. (~QY8JF8T, 01M4RZS8VMJ8TFSA4VTQY8JF8T)

#### Changed

- goway gains its command line skeleton: run, status, gc, doctor, host, ssh and config verbs, colored output and a faithful exit code contract (125 for goway failures). (~FMZKNKR, 01M418J2MCP8Y962617FMZKNKR)
- goway reads its host pool from ~/.config/goway/config.toml (unknown keys rejected), caches last good addresses, pins each host's ssh key to its name rather than its IP, and adds goway host list, goway host remove and goway config path. (~2Y6VZWP, 01M418J2PA3M2FESKBF2Y6VZWP)
- goway host add NAME finds a host with no static IP (cached address, configured address, DNS, NAME.local, and Windows mDNS through WSL interop), checks it is the intended Linux machine and pins its ssh key; resolution falls through stale addresses automatically. (~1JJVK4G, 01M418J2R4E5AMB16T81JJVK4G)
- goway syncs exactly the work tree git shows (tracked, modified and untracked-but-not-ignored files, never .env files) to a per-worktree seed on the remote, sending only changed files as a tar stream with mtimes preserved so remote cargo builds stay warm; no rsync needed on either side. (~3K8SFYY, 01M418J2SVQ1TDSVW4Y3K8SFYY)
- goway run -- CMD runs a command on a host from a fresh hard-linked work directory with a warm per-repository cargo target slot (and sccache when installed), streams stdout and stderr untouched, exits with the command's code (128+N on signals, 130 on Ctrl-C, 125 for goway failures), stops the remote job when interrupted, removes the work directory unless --keep, and writes host, arch and address with --report. (~ZWZN75P, 01M418J2VJ0VQANJXMWZWZN75P)
- goway run without --host probes every configured host in parallel (one ssh call each) and runs on the one with the lowest (load + goway jobs) / cores, skipping unreachable hosts and hosts at max_jobs. (~5Z33GCC, 01M418J2XBD2XSQ98NG5Z33GCC)
- goway gc removes stale remote state on every host (orphaned work dirs after 1 day, --keep dirs after 3 days, seeds and caches after 7 idle days, never anything locked by a run), with --host, --repo, --older-than, --all and --dry-run; every goway run also collects expired entries on its host automatically. (~Z51Y5V2, 01M418J2Z5HBMC6KQVKZ51Y5V2)
- goway status probes every host in parallel and shows its current address and how it was found, arch, cores, load, running goway jobs, disk used by goway and free disk, marking unreachable hosts. (~RMFMZCQ, 01M418J30Y9712W7GABRMFMZCQ)
- goway doctor [HOST] checks each host's remote prerequisites, Rust toolchain (cargo, linker, cargo-nextest, sccache), disk and sshd password login plus the local ssh setup, printing the exact fix for each problem; --fix runs the user-level fixes, and fixes that need root are only run with --sudo (over an interactive session) after explaining why. (~CRZ9PR0, 01M418J32MGNAKS09XECRZ9PR0)
- goway ssh setup HOST makes key login work with one password login (an existing agent or default key, or goway's own key kept in goway's config dir with a user-only ACL on Windows), fixes ~/.ssh and authorized_keys modes on the host, and goway ssh setup HOST --undo reverts exactly those changes. (~3P6E2E9, 01M418J34BQHTC06ZJD3P6E2E9)
- The installer and SSH setup gain a write-ahead change journal whose replay restores the system to its state before the install. (~QQRVXW2, 01M418J36509PKTMG2WQQRVXW2)
- goway-setup.exe installs the goway client for the current user (copies goway.exe, adds it to the user Path, registers an Add/Remove Programs entry) and uninstalls it by replaying a journal, restoring the machine exactly. (~PPMS0PF, 01M418J37YMHXD44VH1PPMS0PF)
- goway-setup install --host sets up a Windows machine as a goway build host (mirrored .wslconfig, firewall and Hyper-V firewall rules, WSL keepalive task, WSL sshd) with every change journaled, and uninstall restores the prior state without ever purging packages. (~RN5XHS5, 01M418J39QGM7X2XQ32RN5XHS5)
- scripts/install.sh installs goway per user into ~/.local/bin (adding a marked PATH line to ~/.profile only when needed) and journals every change, so scripts/uninstall.sh restores the home directory exactly. (~17X1700, 01M418J3BG08155MM6317X1700)
- Documentation for configuration, host identity and address resolution, everyday usage (run, status, gc, doctor, exit codes, what is sent) and a README. (~VRM4GF4, 01M4199C9FKB1AK9J77VRM4GF4)
- docs/positioning.md states goway's niche (whole commands from a dirty work tree onto personal, DHCP-addressed machines with zero remote footprint) and the rules by which it coexists with sccache-dist, Bazel, Docker, CI runners and other build systems. (~P30JZFT, 01M41AV19BKENE773F9P30JZFT)
- Remote jobs run as polite guests by default (priority = "low": nice 10 and idle-class I/O; priority = "normal" opts out), and max_load skips hosts whose load per core is already above a ceiling unless pinned with --host. (~AZXATFK, 01M41AV1CP5ATYMNAS1AZXATFK)
- goway now only fills in build settings that are unset: an existing CARGO_TARGET_DIR, RUSTC_WRAPPER (empty disables sccache), SCCACHE_DIR or SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT from the remote environment or --env wins, and runs leave no files outside the remote root and no processes behind. (~YCXEWYB, 01M41AV1FXKNJQD47M4YCXEWYB)
- A new worktree's first sync starts from a sibling seed of the same repository and skips files whose content is unchanged, so only real differences cross the network; deletions travel over stdin (no 128 KiB argument limit), and a seed replaced by gc mid-sync is detected and resynced instead of producing a partial tree. (~NPS2P1Y, 01M41BWCNK0QQQC119DNPS2P1Y)
- goway host add now explains why a candidate was rejected (for example a hostname mismatch), keeps a config file's leading comments above new hosts, and GOWAY_WINDOWS_LOOKUP=0 turns off the Windows name lookup under WSL. (~KK754K3, 01M41DJE8ZZJXCHY01NKK754K3)
- A helper whose owner is using it (on battery or recently at the keyboard) is never skipped but scores slightly worse, and jobs there run at nice 19 with half the cores for builds; an unreadable state counts as unknown and changes nothing. (~FMD718W, 01M41DQSJZS28G72PJWFMD718W)
- scripts/windows/build.sh builds x64 and native ARM64 installers, and the release workflow proves the ARM64 files run natively on a Windows on ARM runner. (~HMA8K5M, 01M41DQSMXMRTN3BNYBHMA8K5M)
- goway's own lines now name their kind in words (error, warning, failed, note, done, info, next) so meaning never depends on color, a failing command is reported as failed, and the common errors (unreachable host, key refused, host key changed, not in a git project, no usable host) end with the next step to take. (~SZ2EHXD, 01M41J9EDG2P620PVQSSZ2EHXD)
- A newcomer guide: the README is a per-machine quick start (one command on each helper, one install and one goway add per helper on the main laptop) with every 'what this changes and why' in a collapsed section, plus a plain-words glossary and a troubleshooting page keyed by the messages goway prints. (~0T4AJ4Y, 01M41J9EX971GXX8QJZ0T4AJ4Y)
- Releases: CI checks every push on Linux and Windows; a version tag builds static Linux binaries (x86_64, aarch64), goway-setup.exe (x64, ARM64), SHA256SUMS and install.sh with build provenance attestations; and curl ... install.sh | bash downloads the right binary and refuses it unless its checksum matches. (~9WA8S1D, 01M41J9F9X5EXN9SS579WA8S1D)
- Accessibility: --plain (or GOWAY_PLAIN=1) prints status, doctor and host tables as labelled lines (host: helios, load: 0.40, ...) that screen readers read well. (~0MWPSWG, 01M41K9Y2VNX7T4HRTW0MWPSWG)
- The README now opens with a table of what each operating system can be (Windows with or without WSL, Linux, macOS; main laptop or helper) with install steps for each, and every command uses obvious placeholders like <YOUR-COMPUTER-NAME-HERE> with a note on how to find the value. (~3K99JS8, 01M41MRT8JQQGXY0HXH3K99JS8)
- The README now explains how goway's installers and setup commands are undone: every change is journaled with its prior state before it is made, uninstall replays the journal backwards, and the exact guarantee (everything restored, your later edits kept, system packages listed rather than removed) and the tests that prove it are stated. (~KYWG47Q, 01M41N12A8CCPCQZMZFKYWG47Q)
- The README now follows the house style (banner, badges, install matrix, sixty-second tour with a terminal image, command table, development, versioning, contributing, security and license sections), and the repository has LICENSE (MIT), SECURITY.md (private vulnerability reporting), CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md. (~JY6TJJK, 01M41NJTAHEM3NRKHN1JY6TJJK)
- The README banner's laptop screens now show their text centered. (~H79PW2Y, 01M41NTZB23WDHTKT7YH79PW2Y)
- The README now has an operating system matrix and a language matrix, each row marked tested or untested by the maintainer. (~RP5W380, 01M41P2G3B4MTA0WSNVRP5W380)
- The banner arrows now leave and enter the laptops flat, the command on the main laptop is one color with a line continuation, and the README links the Releases page. (~T8N0K8R, 01M41PFJGMFY6AP509MT8N0K8R)
- goway and goway-journal are now published to crates.io by the release workflow after the GitHub release succeeds (goway-setup never is), and CI dry-runs the publish on every push. (~NW25FJX, 01M41PH8825T7M1779CNW25FJX)
- goway is now published to PyPI on every release tag as maturin wheels (manylinux and musllinux for x86_64 and aarch64, Windows x86_64) plus an sdist through trusted publishing, so uv tool install goway and pipx install goway work; CI builds a wheel and runs goway --version from a clean venv on every push. (~EQP9WA8, 01M41PH8AS2GRS0FJ5PEQP9WA8)
- Document that Windows 10 and NAT-mode laptops can be helpers through the port relay goway-setup installs (untested on real Windows 10). (~TZ6NS2D, 01M41Q4WBSNPAW83SGMTZ6NS2D)
- Documented running a Windows test suite and clippy from WSL through goway, replacing winsync, winrun and winbuild. (~XKXW2BJ, 01M41Q6DT69P172DECKXKXW2BJ)
- The release workflow can be run by hand as a dry run that builds every artifact without publishing, and all actions now run on Node 24. (~B5DPKXF, 01M41QXBJQSNY0SFGH8B5DPKXF)
- The banner leaves more space between the goway wordmark and its subtitle. (~V70YJYH, 01M41QY6JHYQHZQG4E2V70YJYH)
- Resolve tries every address after a host-key or auth refusal, tar archiving re-checks each opened file against links and junctions, and hosts default to max_jobs = cores/2. (~YNB953N, 01M41RBQN1TKQ4AM7HMYNB953N)
- Nested goway is bounded by GOWAY_DEPTH (limit 4, exit 125 naming the chain), and automatic gc takes a per-root lock. (~X6SY2NM, 01M41TY572561EPG8TRX6SY2NM)
- Hosts without max_jobs now default to half their cores (at least 1) in the pool and in status. (~5MMJ7N2, 01M4219T92MBXK35BWZ5MMJ7N2)
- Releases are cut from goway-vX.Y.Z tags: the workflow checks the tag against the Cargo version before publishing, then publishes the GitHub release and, independently, crates.io and PyPI through their protected environments. (~XQ6C1D9, 01M421JZEKNNR41FFNAXQ6C1D9)
- The README links every release file directly, says which computer each is for, and explains how to check a download against SHA256SUMS and its build attestation. (~YRZ7DVB, 01M423G9NDKE227KXWXYRZ7DVB)
- Windows helpers run a whole run on three PowerShell starts instead of about eight (one session per host, a gc only when something is due, no WMI on the hot path): a warm run's overhead fell from about 8.5 s to under 4 s on a busy machine. (~3JJQ4YK, 01M4264NEAS0KYAAM0X3JJQ4YK)
- The whole test suite now passes on macOS with no skips (shard detection, nested runs, copy verification, slot cleanup, sync protocol), after fixing a pipe-inheritance race that made helper calls wait for unrelated jobs on macOS. (~3C33N2D, 01M429PSDPQ96TAGQ4W3C33N2D)
- A helper without max_jobs now accepts as many goway jobs at once as it has cores (it was half); jobs stay niced. (~FZE14XF, 01M42DHQZV1Y0SB90MZFZE14XF)
- Every probe now records how far the helper clock is from this machine. (~591BBA2, 01M42TD5V6H043JYBGK591BBA2)
- The probe and doctor report the helper wall clock so goway can measure its offset. (~C77Y6CE, 01M42TDEA5GVVB5R23YC77Y6CE)
- The README explains why goway instead of a Kubernetes cluster or Docker, and when those are the better choice. (~QVJQFJR, 01M43BR5Y9TSZXKPEYJQVJQFJR)
- Runs of one repository started together no longer both pick a helper that has disk for only one: pending claims set aside the repository's footprint. (~D0GB213, 01M43CFMDFG8YSM3HNRD0GB213)
- CI now kills any single test after five minutes (ten for the heavy suites), limits every job, and prints the stuck process tree and its pipes on macOS. (~VDZE455, 01M43RNR0H7WHXDXKTKVDZE455)
- Every change goway or goway-setup makes to a machine is now journaled and listed by goway changes, non-invertible actions are recorded and reported by undo, doctor installs of pinned tools and rustup targets undo exactly, and a test fails the build when a machine change appears outside the journal-backed modules. (~XV3QHHT, 01M44GXPWBS9QVWWPKRXV3QHHT)

#### Fixed

- The test suite passes when run on goway hosts themselves (no WSL interop inside ssh sessions, no inherited CARGO_TARGET_DIR), and goway is an allowed frob evidence tool so evidence can be measured on a named host. (~KPG1CN6, 01M41ET2429M1P5KR3BKPG1CN6)
- Fixed: warm cargo runs could execute test binaries whose baked CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR pointed at a previous, deleted work directory; a run holding target slot k now runs in a stable per-slot tree, so reused binaries always see the current sources. (~PFDSEFK, 01M41F1RCK7DZQNPXF6PFDSEFK)
- Fixed: goway uninstall could report a run in progress right after a run (the post-run cleanup holds locks for moments); purge now waits briefly. The Windows build no longer warns about Unix-only test helpers. (~N0ZAD7T, 01M41KY0RME1HZ0SC8SN0ZAD7T)
- Output from sharded runs and goway's own messages is written one whole line at a time under a single lock, with long lines split and partial last lines terminated. (~YZ9GC8F, 01M41R6XC8FGG8NC36TYZ9GC8F)
- The integration tests no longer depend on sleeps and offsets: runs hold their slots until released and tests wait on conditions. (~JY6AG0H, 01M41RBQJ30AQHAETMSJY6AG0H)
- Same-size edits made within one second of the previous sync now reach the helper's build slot instead of leaving stale content. (~QNTX8FZ, 01M41TNZH9N2J377DRPQNTX8FZ)
- Files a run writes into a build slot now get the current time as mtime, so make, ninja and cargo rebuild after switching to an older branch. (~9BP2Y3B, 01M41XXHHF40BZ2VV9K9BP2Y3B)
- goway run --shard now detects real Catch2 v3 binaries (marker catch2-version), and CI builds real GoogleTest and Catch2 binaries to keep detection honest. (~KKNQADN, 01M41Y4SBE4HN9SNMJ2KKNQADN)
- The shares note of a weighted sharded run lists hosts largest share first, so the output no longer depends on the order the pool picked them. (~K2BXN3N, 01M41ZE1AJB704T3YPAK2BXN3N)
- gc no longer removes a starting run after a helper clock jump (liveness and the monotonic clock protect it), and files dated in the helper future neither warn nor rebuild. (~VAJPQC3, 01M4244944C4E8RTVK8VAJPQC3)
- A work directory that cannot be removed at the end of a run no longer turns a good run into exit 125; gc also stops re-creating the lock file of a run that is finishing. (~7JEJJBC, 01M424ART4FM9FJFZSY7JEJJBC)
- Test runs that are held open now release themselves on drop and end on their own if the test dies, so no poller outlives a test. (~DFXCR9H, 01M424SYTP00R9JM9XDDFXCR9H)
- A job whose client was killed or vanished is now stopped by the helper through a heartbeat lifeline instead of running on for hours. (~WXVMJKT, 01M4256TBME68EPWC1PWXVMJKT)
- Windows PowerShell 5.1 stamp test no longer depends on Copy-Item preserving mtimes. (~YKF9Q5D, 01M426PCBA3AW3Q3XXMYKF9Q5D)
- The integration test world pins max_jobs so small CI runners no longer skip the test host. (~5Q8MZ12, 01M426WGCR6P6K9M8PX5Q8MZ12)
- The same-second slot test no longer fails on slow or loaded helpers; it was timing-dependent, the product was correct. (~DZH68F2, 01M4270T48THMRV136CDZH68F2)
- Windows PowerShell 5.1: the helper no longer feeds git a byte-order mark, so ignored files stay in a warm slot instead of being deleted every run. (~YRM1N6N, 01M4289F32807B7P88QYRM1N6N)
- goway finds Linux helpers advertised by avahi through the Windows lookup: it no longer asks Windows for A records only, which failed for them. (~PYDHSTK, 01M42B5FH3SSX7Z89VQPYDHSTK)
- Helpers whose shell startup files print text, or whose login shell is fish or csh, no longer corrupt goway's protocol. (~QGP7M3S, 01M42BHRJCBSSQZ6GWNQGP7M3S)
- goway counts the failed logins it causes per helper and stops at 2 from automatic probing and 4 overall, so fail2ban and sshguard never ban the laptop, and reports a probable ban with the fail2ban-client commands to lift it. (~VCXDFW2, 01M42BHSGD4HSJY1GQXVCXDFW2)
- goway-setup install --host --dry-run now prints its plan on an elevated Windows machine whose WSL distro is not running. (~SSBC8M1, 01M42CDHAVDBNFHDW8MSSBC8M1)
- doctor --fix reports each root fix on its own, runs apt-get update once per session, and installs a pinned mold under ~/.local/opt where the distribution has no package. (~06S3H6W, 01M42DTSTPRJRVKFED406S3H6W)
- The test suite now runs on git 2.25, and goway finds a repository's common directory without git 2.31's --path-format, so worktrees of one repository share their seed on older git. (~MR97WNB, 01M42E8Z94EFYWZ4XYMMR97WNB)
- A Windows host's first sync into an empty goway root no longer fails with seed changed, and interop errors no longer say ssh. (~1TD3D5H, 01M42FEZBPMJ958RA4K1TD3D5H)
- The owner-awareness tests no longer assume a runner's niceness or idle time, so they pass on macOS. (~B9V2YY4, 01M42JQMHSDJS2ASHQEB9V2YY4)
- The quiet doctor output test no longer assumes bash passes on every host (macOS CI). (~CDZ3HFD, 01M42K43FTZJG00K25DCDZ3HFD)
- Many concurrent runs to one helper now spread over a few shared ssh connections, so its session limit is never hit, and stale control sockets are replaced quietly. (~82TBT2S, 01M42MNTTGT910S380T82TBT2S)
- sccache is started from a stable, short directory with its socket moved to an owner-only runtime directory when paths are deep, so builds no longer fail with a stale server or a socket path that is too long. (~CEQNJYE, 01M42S1G5V31GB7HCE7CEQNJYE)
- Shard and --each-os lines and reports name the OS the host reported. (~S4SAKKH, 01M439YZ808PY91MXTGS4SAKKH)
- A run no longer slips onto a local machine that is already at max_jobs while another run is still taking its slot. (~5WD6GZ8, 01M43CN2BHDHCJ18X175WD6GZ8)
- Making room before a run no longer evicts the run's own seed, work dir or cache. (~5YX9H8Q, 01M43CZG0V20SHCRVJ75YX9H8Q)
- The weighted-shard tests no longer fail on a heavily loaded machine. (~2EV35AH, 01M43E7SEV5NNR69D6Y2EV35AH)
- Fixed two Windows remote_ps1 tests. (~1K7C6WG, 01M43EA8EVNNKP6PV8B1K7C6WG)
- A shared sccache server left broken on a helper by an older goway is detected and restarted before the next run, instead of failing every build. (~GDD7F0D, 01M43EG3SHVE0BBZHEQGDD7F0D)
- The scratch_fs tests ask the temp directory whether it ignores case instead of assuming Linux, so they pass on macOS. (~D6024D0, 01M43EWZGMJC3DDZRGAD6024D0)
- The clock-jump gc test no longer fails on a host that booted under two minutes ago. (~3NH9TEV, 01M43F5FVHYP8YH6FXM3NH9TEV)
- The translate tests use real temp paths and an absolute pwsh, so they pass on macOS. (~JGBJ33M, 01M43FANDGFZY0NRW51JGBJ33M)
- The footprint tests make their fake df a shell function, so Homebrew GNU tools cannot shadow it on macOS. (~ACGZN8W, 01M43FGZX6DMY6VWYE7ACGZN8W)
- The queue test no longer fails when runs finish before the next one arrives. (~QK28058, 01M43FHS0TS6TTT9VF8QK28058)
- A macOS helper now measures a job's peak memory by sampling its process group. (~1WYK8J5, 01M43GWXKVF2RFVTAHR1WYK8J5)
- The creator-pid gc test no longer fails on a host that booted under two minutes ago. (~MJX7FJR, 01M43GX33SPA3ED3YC2MJX7FJR)
- A live run's work dir is never evicted (liveness by lock and process), the lifeline waits 120 seconds of silence and says why it stopped a job, and --report is written even when the run fails early. (~AN2R646, 01M43JAQ5BAK00HD28RAN2R646)
- The queue arrival-order test staggers arrivals by 60 ms so macOS scheduler jitter cannot reorder them. (~HJXG220, 01M43MRTMQHWGKJ683VHJXG220)
- Every child goway starts now goes through the spawn lock, which removes an intermittent macOS hang where a run waited on a pipe its own lifeline connection had inherited. (~E09XD8K, 01M43QA57XZY29C6T6SE09XD8K)
- Windows helpers now end the lifeline at once on closed input, wait 120 s on silence, say why a run was stopped, and gc skips a work dir whose runner or job is alive. (~RV6ZEKH, 01M43QZJJJRG844E9KHRV6ZEKH)
- The remote lifeline now tells a silent client from a closed connection on macOS's bash 3.2, so the recorded reason is right. (~JS14CQ5, 01M43S56R7BSW1JHQ0JJS14CQ5)
- The disk budget test now kills its lock holder's whole process group, so no sleep child outlives it. (~61GZVB4, 01M43S56WE4YZD6YZMF61GZVB4)
- A run on macOS no longer prints a bash job-control Terminated line for its stopped watchdog on stderr. (~GDQV589, 01M43YEHCZ9GFBARCGJGDQV589)
- A recorded memory or disk footprint no longer locks a run out: --host warns instead of refusing, --ignore-footprint (or --needs mem>=0) skips the checks, a run no helper could fit goes to the largest one, and peaks are PSS-measured, the maximum of the last five runs, shown in status and reset by gc --repo. (~AW0DHW0, 01M43Z0NPW4WH9YNZGXAW0DHW0)
- A run's wait for a free build slot on a helper is now bounded by --wait, says how many slots are busy and how long the oldest holder has run, and exits 125 on timeout (Unix and Windows helpers). (~D2QQV2Q, 01M44F0H5R09BNX6PJWD2QQV2Q)
- A helper now stops a job's whole systemd scope (and any process tagged with its run) when its client vanishes or its leader exits with background processes still running, so none outlives its run or holds its build slot. (~SZFHCRG, 01M44F3BBCMAXQNP7H2SZFHCRG)
- The WSL keepalive task now repeats every few minutes so a distro that WSL shut down comes back on its own, and an install replaces an old boot-only task through the journal. (~D88MA1B, 01M44GSQRZKTKK2HS91D88MA1B)
- A run behind a queue head that cannot fit is no longer blocked forever (later runs may pass it a bounded number of times), and memory admission now uses peaks estimated from other hosts, admits one run per host while no peak is known, runs alone on an idle host short of free memory, and fails at once when a peak exceeds a host's total memory. (~9SKK7DR, 01M44Q40P0JX72QMP799SKK7DR)
- Doctor's WSL-down check now kills a hung wsl.exe on the helper after 10 seconds and reports the WSL service as not responding with recovery steps. (~ENKASAM, 01M44Q7WQ0R1E74ZWYEENKASAM)
- Windows helpers work again: the bounded build-slot wait sits inside the run verb of remote.ps1 instead of at the top of the script. (~KMJRY4R, 01M44S31BX2R53R7245KMJRY4R)
- The slot-wait test no longer fails on small CI runners: its test host skips the per-job memory admission so the run reaches the helper-side slot wait. (~26Q32N8, 01M44T21V22BFFM7DRS26Q32N8)
- A run on a helper without systemd no longer reports its own helper processes as leftovers of the job. (~CDMA5DG, 01M44T3VY7H4QFZRRXYCDMA5DG)
- The slot-wait test no longer hangs on CI: its overlapping runs of one repository skip the footprint admission, and a held run that never starts shows its stderr. (~EM10R1J, 01M44V923VV7R5AT0NVEM10R1J)
- The job-limit tests expect a systemd scope only on Linux and clamp the ulimit cap to the limit a job inherits, so macOS CI passes. (~CBV8T5J, 01M44VAJ9FGTQSC9KGPCBV8T5J)
- The queue order test judges first come first served by actual arrival and the queue's own overtaking bound, so a slow runner does not fail it. (~1ABKWDY, 01M44VAJE0Z7NQ4YQGK1ABKWDY)
- The make-room test checks the run's seed from inside the run instead of racing the detached post-run sweep, so it holds on macOS. (~91SRWC6, 01M44VAJJGDGQTGJ5NK91SRWC6)
- A seed evicted between the manifest and the hash check no longer fails the run; the sync retries through the generation check. (~ZJ1S3ZR, 01M44W77K3QCMJXX5QNZJ1S3ZR)
- On WSL helpers goway now measures the Windows drive that holds the virtual disk (not just the ext4 figure), keeps a configurable reserve on it (win_reserve, default the larger of 15 GiB and 5 percent), evicts idle caches and then refuses a run below the reserve, sizes the default disk budget from the real drive, sets the disk sparse and enables fstrim.timer through goway-setup install or tune --sparse, and doctor warns with the fix and the one-time compaction steps. (~KZE0GWF, 01M44WPJWSD12YH6MEZKZE0GWF)
- The job-scope test skips, saying why, on a machine without cgroup v2. (~YT0QS1A, 01M44YARTF6NAN21B2WYT0QS1A)
- The default per-job task cap is now derived from the helper (half of its threads-max, floored at 16384) instead of a fixed 4096 that starved builds and test runs. (~ZQ447N2, 01M451D50SW5GSZDGSMZQ447N2)
- Test worlds now stop the sccache server their runs started, so a full test suite no longer exhausts a job's task cap. (~5HN8AZK, 01M451F9V3WBZM37PF85HN8AZK)
- The end-of-run sweep no longer stops goway's shared sccache server or prints permission errors, and names any real leftover by pid and command. (~V630TRA, 01M4521XH97V8EXXK8RV630TRA)
- Tests now run remote.sh from its file, and a unit test guards the encoded command line against the single-argument limit. (~RV593VK, 01M452F1868GJRP418YRV593VK)
- The tmpdir probe no longer prints environ permission errors, and the full suite passes again. (~A1AEG0B, 01M454E0P4PG2XC8NFEA1AEG0B)
- The end-of-run sweep no longer reports the watchdog's own short sleep as a leftover on a loaded helper. (~BJKDGAR, 01M454TH22DPTG1J88CBJKDGAR)
- The test suite builds and passes on macOS again: tests of Linux-only cleanup and WSL paths are limited to Linux. (~119KERS, 01M455YWY9KTYZNB25D119KERS)
- Concurrent cargo runs on one helper now share its cores: each gets an equal share as its job count, exports MOLD_JOBS and GOWAY_LINK_THREADS (unless set), and placement counts a running build as half the host, so an idle helper wins over a saturated one. (~EW8738V, 01M48MPBRZBVGBP1JF5EW8738V)
- A helper smaller than a repository's recorded memory peak now runs a cargo or nextest run at the job count its learned fixed-plus-per-job memory model allows, cramped idle helpers rank last, a child killed by the OOM killer (cargo exit 101) raises the estimate, and a run cut short by a lost client no longer records a partial peak. (~K60F05J, 01M4A8H1DWYN24DXSPMK60F05J)
- A helper that has recorded memory levels of its own for a repository is now fitted from them alone, so another helper's heavier levels no longer refuse it. (~D4HTVG7, 01M4GMWH31KWNZ5VHK9D4HTVG7)

#### Security

- goway-setup now keeps host install state in an administrator-only directory and refuses to elevate on anything a non-administrator could have planted: journal entries are validated against the host plan, firewall and task names match exactly, system tools run by absolute path, and only the host component elevates. (~8M94XF7, 01M41G473Q46HGXFM2A8M94XF7)
- goway-setup --host now limits its firewall rules to the Private and Domain profiles and the local subnet (wider only with --allow-from CIDR), disables sshd password login by default once a key is authorized (--no-harden to opt out), and warns loudly when no key exists yet or the active network is Public. (~0PAATV1, 01M41G47WFREN69859J0PAATV1)
- Security: goway host add and goway ssh setup pin a new host's key only after you confirm its fingerprint (at the terminal or with --fingerprint), and ssh setup asks for the password only after that, so a machine impersonating the name on the network can neither be pinned nor receive the password. (~QS3GJHQ, 01M41G48MQT87PV0WBJQS3GJHQ)
- Fixed: a deletion list stored by a sync whose upload failed could later delete files that had been restored; deletions are now bound to the sync attempt that computed them. (~8YMQWGV, 01M41G48SYNXD0DAT528YMQWGV)
- Fixed: a job that wrote a tracked file in place could change the synced seed and other runs sharing its hard links; each run now gets a real (reflinked where possible) copy. (~V39HJ02, 01M41G48ZSY788REK7AV39HJ02)
- Security: goway gc now removes only entries goway labelled, only under a root marked as goway's, and remote_root must be a dedicated directory (not the home directory, /, or a path with ..). (~JXH361J, 01M41G4977R6YQJNT25JXH361J)
- Security: everything goway prints itself is stripped of control characters (a host can no longer inject terminal escapes through its hostname or errors), and host probes with non-finite, negative or absurd load, core or job values are rejected. (~MKRRE51, 01M41G49E3ZHDEV6ST5MKRRE51)
- Security: --env values now reach the host over ssh's stdin into an owner-only file deleted at job start, instead of the remote command line (visible to other users on the host), and goway's debug log no longer prints command arguments. (~91P2Y64, 01M41G49PSNGVFHZGPM91P2Y64)
- Security: host names are validated by the argument parser (1-63 letters, digits, - or _), so a malformed name can no longer write a wildcard key alias or a file outside goway's config directory. (~EA0DRCN, 01M41G49ZQGA15P0674EA0DRCN)
- Security: goway keeps secret-looking files local by default (case-insensitive env files, credential files, private keys and key stores, and the contents of .ssh, .aws and .gnupg directories), lists what it kept back, never reads files under symlinked directories, and secret_allow sends specific ones anyway; the send_env_files setting is now send_secret_files. (~3E03EBQ, 01M41G4A56Y42F0Y77X3E03EBQ)
- Security: every ssh call goway makes disables agent, X11 and port forwarding, credential delegation, local commands and host key updates regardless of the user's ssh config, and ssh runs with a minimal environment so no local variable can be forwarded to a host. (~9Q6MXYM, 01M41G4AAB7P5DXDP959Q6MXYM)
- Security: goway's sccache server now listens on a unix socket inside the owner-only cache directory instead of a predictable TCP port other users on the host could reach. (~RHVPGCP, 01M41G4AG3AFPNS7Y52RHVPGCP)
- Security: a fork or other clone that shares a repository's root commit but not its origin now gets separate remote caches (worktrees of one clone still share theirs), and the docs state that runs execute repository code as your user on the host. (~16W3VKV, 01M41G4AMWANFMSM4N616W3VKV)
- Security hardening: non-UTF-8 file names fail loudly instead of being dropped; goway's files are written atomically (new ones owner-only, existing ones keep their mode) and authorized_keys is replaced atomically on hosts; the ssh control directory is 0700; the post-setup key check never reuses a password session; doctor installs pinned, sha256-verified nextest and sccache releases and never pastes host-reported text into commands; ssh setup --key chooses the public key (only .pub files are read); install.sh refuses prefixes a shell could run as code. (~P6GX8J7, 01M41G4ASVEX0XCD8SVP6GX8J7)
- Purge now removes only goway's own work, seed and cache entries, goway refuses to adopt a non-empty foreign directory as its root, and remote_root must end in a name containing goway. (~6DRMBQH, 01M41PJM11R43EY25RJ6DRMBQH)
- On a terminal, goway now strips OSC, DCS, APC, PM and SOS strings, non-color CSI sequences and other control characters from remote output (use --output=raw to opt out); pipes and files are never filtered. (~FBC6XMB, 01M41PQMJFBRT1G5MZNFBC6XMB)
- The secret-file denylist now also keeps cargo credentials, Terraform state and variables, kubeconfigs, vault and database tokens, password stores and similar files on the laptop. (~GZZEDKG, 01M41Q1BTPDXN7HY00QGZZEDKG)
- goway-setup no longer prints an unvalidated WSL user name in the paste-able goway add command and strips control and bidi characters from every system-derived text it prints. (~WMMTNRW, 01M41Q5QV6WPG98DFF5WMMTNRW)
- Uninstall no longer runs command text read from the local install record or journal: undo commands are derived from known check names, the install journal is only applied to the goway binary, ~/.profile and directories under home (CRLF kept), and rustup is kept when ~/.cargo existed before. (~K5PTA8D, 01M41Q7VQKB1DCE9BY6K5PTA8D)
- Host-supplied text in goway's own messages can no longer forge goway: lines or hide content with bidi characters, and output captured from a helper is size-capped. (~B7ANNPX, 01M41QK0N9EG1DA8BZFB7ANNPX)
- install.sh is now a single function called on its last line so a truncated download runs nothing, it refuses non-https release URLs, appends the goway directory to PATH instead of prepending it, and clears the journal of an aborted install. (~FBZ9QNV, 01M41QR7H2C1A75HQ31FBZ9QNV)
- goway now disables ssh multiplexing when its control directory is not private to the user, calls sudo by absolute path, checks sshd -t before reloading and falls back to the sshd unit, and documents that the identity setting limits which keys a helper sees. (~989W2W7, 01M41QX825GRFPE7AQP989W2W7)
- gc no longer removes a work dir that a run has just created and not yet locked, even with --all. (~G6TWVCV, 01M41R19SCCEB1DAM0JG6TWVCV)
- ssh setup now pins only the host key you confirmed, clears a stale scratch known_hosts, prefers goway's own key, and authorizes it with no-agent-forwarding, no-port-forwarding and no-X11-forwarding. (~96778YV, 01M41R5BZDA7D7SDB9W96778YV)
- The host install now elevates a private copy of goway-setup that is hashed and held with write, rename and delete denied for the whole elevated run, instead of relaunching the user-writable download. (~S23E98H, 01M41RK5DS18D9BG923S23E98H)
- goway-setup refuses --allow-from ranges wider than /8 (IPv4) or /16 (IPv6) unless --allow-wide is given, and always refuses ranges containing 0.0.0.0, :: or multicast space. (~NFFPK09, 01M41RK5G48AYWK5ATTNFFPK09)
- The elevated goway-setup child no longer follows symbolic links or reparse points when it edits .wslconfig, and the elevated uninstall now checks that every recorded prior value fits the change that produced it. (~E9RC5C4, 01M41RK5J5QNHGAZRCBE9RC5C4)
- The NAT relay now forwards only to a private address inside the WSL adapter subnet (checked at creation and by the refresh script), scheduled tasks use absolute System32 paths, goway keeps its Windows config and key out of the roaming profile and restricts the key ACL by SID, and pre-created empty state directories no longer block installs. (~XC3XB05, 01M41RK5MER3TPE7839XC3XB05)
- The NAT relay's elevated refresh task now starts through a native cmd.exe that deletes COR_PROFILER and the other .NET and PowerShell injection variables first; the remaining risk is documented. (~HRP0QGJ, 01M41S2W66SJ4YS2C57HRP0QGJ)
- goway never starts WSL from an elevated process, refuses boot keepalive for administrator accounts with WSL interop on, and doctor and status warn when a helper's WSL interop runs as administrator. (~A4G5EWH, 01M424PG855QPSY3PAKA4G5EWH)
- goway no longer runs cargo, rustc-shim probes or git hooks chosen by a repository on your laptop: requirements are read from manifests, version probes run outside the repository, and git runs with core.fsmonitor and core.hooksPath off. (~PA6WM2T, 01M44C7W7BZNCC912JGPA6WM2T)
- The GitHub release job now needs a reviewer's approval and a tag on main; docs/release.md lists the settings to add. (~G2SFE3P, 01M44CSWKAG8P7C4S2GG2SFE3P)
- A repository can no longer make doctor remove packages: names such as sudo- or curl+ are refused, and package installs use -- with apt --no-remove and pacman --needed. (~893RAE4, 01M44CX1SDVT5JW2N1R893RAE4)
- Arguments sent to Windows helpers can no longer break out of their PowerShell quoting with curly quotes (U+2018 to U+201B), and the printed administrator command no longer includes a key's comment. (~169R3Q0, 01M44DCY5N2R7KWCPZ9169R3Q0)
- The --rsudo administrator routes no longer start goway-setup by name: they run only a copy under Program Files or the administrator-only ProgramData directory after checking its owner and permissions, and otherwise print the command to run by hand. (~P88GWQW, 01M44DSX2K8MN0C65X5P88GWQW)
